_meta.note: Captured off the wire on 2026-11-15: one real `opencode acp` 1.19.1 turn whose ONLY tool call is Kiro Crew's own `wait`, through the `kirocrew-core` server Crew placed on the `session/new` `mcpServers` array; the model was a local stub on a loopback port (no provider credential, no network) with a throwaway HOME, driven to call `wait` once and answer STUB-OK. The scratch gateway was not reachable, so the tool itself refused the call; the frames this fixture is evidence FOR come before that: the `tool_call` names the call only by the fused title `kirocrew-core_wait` with kind `other`, carries no `_meta` and no server field, and `rawInput` is `{}` until the `in_progress` update. Reduced at capture: the session id replaced with the synthetic opencode-session-1 and message ids with msg-N, the available_commands_update inventory dropped, and each configOptions select cut to its current option.
